description:
Python/GenAI Developer 
 Req number: 
R8777 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Remote 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
As a Python/GenAI Developer, you will Build and enhance enterprise AI applications through Python development, Generative AI integration, API design, data processing, and cloud-based deployment. 
 Job Description 
 CAI is seeking a Python/GenAI Developer to build and support Python-based backend services and AI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, FastAPI, and Google Cloud technologies. The role focuses on delivering secure, scalable, and reliable AI-enabled applications while collaborating with business and technical stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle. This position is contract and remote. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design, develop, and maintain Python-based backend services and APIs for AI-enabled applications, with strong emphasis on clean, modular, production-ready code
 Build and integrate Generative AI workflows using LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, and structured-output processing
 Develop FastAPI-based REST endpoints to support file processing, pipeline execution, asynchronous workflows, and integration with external enterprise applications
 Implement retrieval workflows using GCP services such as Vertex AI, Vertex AI Search, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager, and Cloud Run
 Develop data-processing logic for structured and unstructured inputs, including document parsing, metadata generation, validation, transformation, and downstream persistence
 Support integration testing, debugging, deployment, logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting of AI applications across development and QA environments
 Collaborate with solution architects, cloud infrastructure teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working AI features and scalable backend components
 Contribute to prompt engineering, output validation, error handling, retry logic, and guardrails to improve reliability of AI pipeline responses
 Maintain technical documentation, API contracts, configuration files, deployment artifacts, and reusable engineering components
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Minimum 4-7 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on experience in Python backend development; programming fundamentals, object-oriented design, modular coding, exception handling, testing, and package management
 Minimum 1-2 years of practical experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications including prompt engineering, structured outputs, model invocation, response validation, token usage, and basic evaluation concepts
 Minimum 1-2 years of practical experience RAG solutions including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, and grounding
 Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks; endpoint development, request/response models, authentication, async processing, status handling, and API integration
 Hands-on experience working with Google Cloud Platform, especially Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, IAM, and Secret Manager
 Experience integrating AI/ML services into enterprise applications using APIs, authentication, asynchronous processing, and cloud-native services
 Experience with cloud-native development including Docker, service accounts, environment variables, secrets, CI/CD, deployment, and runtime troubleshooting
 Experience processing structured and unstructured data formats such as JSON, JSONL, Excel, CSV, PDF, Word documents, and text
 Experience with source control, CI/CD, containerization, and deployment workflows using Git, Docker, GitLab/GitHub, and cloud deployment pipelines
 Exposure to debugging distributed or cloud-hosted applications using logs, monitoring, request tracing, and error analysis
 Experience working in Agile delivery teams and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders
 Preferred:
 Experience with Agentic AI frameworks or multi-step AI orchestration
 Familiarity with Vertex AI Vector Search, Graph RAG, or knowledge graph concepts
 Experience with Pub/Sub-based asynchronous processing and event-driven architectures
 Understanding of OAuth, service-to-service authentication, IAM, signed URLs, and secure API integration
 Exposure to React or frontend integration is useful but not mandatory
 Familiarity with AI evaluation metrics such as groundedness, relevance, completeness, coherence, and confidence scoring
 Healthcare-domain exposure is beneficial, especially where the solution involves enterprise workflow, requirements, or document intelligence
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
